cards.stem: What term describes forms of the same gene with small differences in DNA bases?
cards.quote: Forms of the same gene with small differences in their sequence of DNA bases are called alleles.

cards.stem: How many copies of each gene does a person typically have?
cards.quote: Typically, people have two copies of each gene, one inherited from each parent.

cards.stem: What do many genes that do not code for proteins do instead?
cards.quote: However, many genes do not code for proteins, instead they help control other genes.

cards.stem: What material are genes made of?
cards.quote: Genes are made up of DNA.
